    'TERI School of Advanced Studies' was established in 1998.

    1162:

    The TERI SAS offers four-year undergraduate programmes (FYUP) and five-year integrated postgraduate programmes (FYIPP). All the programmes have been designed in accordance with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the recent guidelines issued by the University Grants Commission with in-built choices of multiple entry and multiple exit options mapped with employability opportunities.

    1191:

    The strength of the TERI School of Advanced Studies lies in its unique and exciting research and education programmes directed towards enabling and fostering sustainable development. Each programme is multidisciplinary with an emphasis on developing innovative solutions to societal problems. Student’s intellectual curiosity is supported with well- equipped laboratories, replete with advanced equipment and facilities to aid and stimulate research.
